desc: take a picture of the screen
u: gdm-screenshot - take a picture of the screen
gdm-screenshot is a utility for taking screenshots of the entire screen and saving them as PNG image files.

Help Options:

-h, --help
Show help options
--help-all
Show all help options
--help-gtk
Show GTK+ Options

Application Options:

-d, --debug
Debugging output
--display=DISPLAY
X display to use

gdm-screenshot is part of the GDM software package, which is part of the GNOME project. This manpage was written by Nathan Handler <nhandler@ubuntu.com> for the Debian system, but may be used by others.
